name: corroborate-mcp
description: Honest claim corroboration for AI agents: syndication-aware independent-source counting, confidence scores, and published error rates. Keyless, read-only, open source.
long_description: Corroborate tells an AI agent how INDEPENDENTLY a factual/news claim is being reported. It collapses wire/syndication echoes to a single origin, applies a relevance gate, and returns an honest verdict (CONFIRMED = 2+ independent origins | SINGLE_SOURCE | UNCORROBORATED) with per-source evidence, a confidence score, a coverage flag, and plain-English caveats. It measures reporting corroboration, not truth (no stance detection). Keyless and read-only; if all sources are unreachable it errors rather than returning a false negative. Published benchmark error rates ship in the README.

tools.name: corroborate_claim
tools.description: Given a factual/news claim, returns how independently it is being reported: verdict, independent-origin count, per-source evidence, confidence, coverage flag, and honest caveats.

tools.name: find_sources
tools.description: Multi-engine news/source search (Google News, GDELT, Hacker News) for a query: a deduped list of {outlet, domain, url, date} for you to judge yourself.
